Date: 2nd June 2026 
 
Subject: Submission of audio recording of Earnings Conference Call  
Dear Sir/Madam, 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, we wish to inform you that the audio recording of the 
Company’s Earnings Conference Call held today i.e. Tuesday, June 02nd, 2026, to discuss the Audited 
Financial Results for the quarter (Q4) and Financial Year ended March 31, 2026, has been made 
available on the Company’s website.
